meta.title: NFL Analytics & Line Origination — Requirements Register
meta.note: Every requirement below is distilled verbatim-in-intent from the project brief. Status reflects what this session delivered or explicitly flagged; nothing is marked done without a linked artifact.

requirements.text: Collect, organize and analyze using a full list of requirements.
Improve the site to improve decision making.
A dedicated suggestions section where a reviewer can choose the best path before any change is implemented.
requirements.where: analytics-suggestions.html — review workflow (proposed -> reviewed -> accepted/rejected), nothing auto-implemented

requirements.text: A clear list of questions, information and answers that must be addressed before any decision can be reasonably made, based on what we have and do not have; suggestions to discover missing information.
requirements.where: questions.html — Q1-Q20 with have/missing/decision-blocked + discovery suggestions

requirements.text: Originate our own NFL lines (not copied from the market).
Research and develop strategies for generating useful signals.
Treat it as a leaderboard competition that rewards top-performing strategies; cover single bets, parlays and player-prop combos.
Each strategy must pass validation gates before it can score.
Determine correlation values (bet legs, parlays, props).
requirements.status: partial — framework + literature-anchored ranges published; empirical values require tracked picks and market data (flagged)

requirements.text: Remove luck from the equation; build strategies that are selectively skill-based.
Track injuries; know defensive deficiencies (2nd/3rd/4th string replacing starters) and the same for offenses (starters vs backups).
Executive summary of the important details.
No manual input from the owner; work autonomously to completion.
Review the repo line by line; verify from official verified trusted sources; provide links for manual review; flag irregularities; no hallucinations.
requirements.where: research/nfl-week10-verification.md + flagged register + per-row source links

requirements.text: GitHub Pages live site: clean landing page, subpages by category, dashboard UI, all entries and findings in simple table format with analysis.
requirements.where: nfl-analytics.html landing + 7 subpages, styled with the existing site theme

requirements.text: Every table row must have a source link to an official site; values that cannot be confirmed stay blank and are flagged; never infer or fill in values.
Parallel sessions coordinate through COORDINATION.md; claim tasks; no overlapping scopes.
PR to main, merged without waiting; confirm GitHub Pages deploy; record PR and result in COORDINATION.md; publish flagged items on a Flagged for Review page (non-blocking).
requirements.status: in progress (final step of this session)
